hero.title: File:Traymore1930.jpg
hero.description: Amateur photo by unknown photographer of the Traymore Hotel in Altantic City, N.J. circa 1930.  I arrive at that date due to the RCA Victor store pictured.  RCA acquired Victor in 1929 and became known as RCA Victor. Photo was obtained on e-Bay.
categories: Black and white photographs of New Jersey in the 1930s
